description: Consórcios públicos de manejo dos resíduos sólidos (SEMA_2025) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Os consórcios públicos no Ceará, pela característica regionalizada dos aterros a serem implantados, permitem preservar a autonomia dos entes federados e são disciplinados pela Lei nº11.107, de 06 de abril de 2005, e seu Decreto Regulamentar nº 6.017, de 17 de janeiro de 2007. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Consórcios de Resíduos, Associações, Coleta. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
